title: Test handoff storage corruption and concurrency safety
description: Add narrowly scoped flat-file tests proving concurrent append writers do not lose records under the global lock, replace is an atomic same-scope collection rewrite, and malformed JSON, duplicate IDs, invalid timestamps, or invalid field values are reported without modifying the existing store. Include recovery coverage showing all-scope reads or ID purges can inspect/remove syntactically valid orphaned task handoffs.
